# Use basic elements on template

Source : https://learn.sweego.io/docs/templates/use_basic_content_in_template

> You can add and configure elements like Text, Image, Button on your templates.

You can add and configure elements like Text, Image, Button on your templates.

Elements are available on left menu

## **Text:**

Properties that you can configure on a text element:

- Font type

- Font size

- Line-height

- Text color

- Text background color

- Link style

- Link color

- Spacing

![tempplate](undefined)

## **Image:**

To add an image, drag the “Image” icon from the left menu into your template.
Double-click on it to upload your own image.

Properties that you can configure on image:

- Element size

- Image alignment

- Paddings

- Margins

- Border

- Image background

![tempplate](undefined)

## **Button:**

To add a button; drag the "Button" icon from the left menu into your template.
Click on "Clik here to edit me" to set button properties.

Properties that you can configure on a button:

- Element size

- Button alignement

- Button test settings

- Margins

- Paddings

- Border

- Button background
